judged_text: Embed hot path performance regression: `ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`, issuing a DB query (`WHERE lower(host) = ?`) on every `/embed/comments` request, replacing the process-cached `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` which required zero DB traffic; the host list should be cached (process/Redis, invalidated on host CRUD) instead of queried per request

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to `raise ... unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` calls `record_for_host`, which executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), i.e., a DB query per `/embed/comments` request. Previously, `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` used the process-cached SiteSetting string and did not require DB access (method removed in app/models/site_setting.rb). This is a concrete performance/architecture concern introduced by the change, not a functional defect.
